items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: So I brought him up to meet Gail

ctx.x: This was the sort of time when packages were the thing.

Yeah, could do it. Everybody was wondering -- Pasadena printed on the cards and he said Gail called him, Evans come down. Everybody wanted to know who's backing the show. Who's got this show out? Because the stock cards was beautiful. I had a group called the Durmettes, organized a group of girls and had them singing. Well, they

were in the band, too, but they had time to go back and change costumes, different outfit. So it was a big show. It was doing percentage, guaranteed percentage in the theaters. 50 percent houses. It was getting that crowd. They was going after those girls like everything.
